@@ WEAPON
@stat: St
@description:
 WEAPON • 1-Handed Concussion These skills
 include weapon skills utilizing one-handed crushing weapons. Maces, clubs
 and morning stars all fall into category. WEAPON • 1-Handed Edged These
 skills include weapon skills utilizing one-handed slashing weapons. Most
 swords, daggers and other small bladed weapons all fall into this category.
 WEAPON • 2-Handed These skills include all weapons which require two hands
 wield. Quarterstaves, flails, two-handed swords and the like fall into this
 category. WEAPON • Missile These skills include all bow and sling weapons.
 This also includes crossbows. WEAPON • Missile Artillery These skills
 include all heavy medieval weaponry, from catapults to trebuchets. WEAPON
 • Pole Arms These skills include all polearms, from halberds to pikes the
 ever-popular glaive-guisarme. WEAPON • Thrown This category encompasses
 the use of all thrown weapons, from thrown knives and javelins.
